Container.Name: AssettoMan
Container.Overview: Assetto Corsa / Assetto Corsa Competizione dedicated server manager. Manages game server containers via the Docker socket, with full config UIs, mod hosting and a public community page.
Container.Requires: Login to ghcr.io first: docker login ghcr.io -u Josifjoey

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, server files, mods and uploads

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Required — lets AssettoMan create and control game server containers

Config.Name: HOST_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Host path matching the Data volume above (used for game container bind mounts)

Config.Name: GAME_HOST
Config.Description: Unraid host IP (fallback for querying AC server HTTP status API)

Config.Name: COOKIE_SECURE
Config.Description: Set true when serving over HTTPS (e.g. via Cloudflare Tunnel)
